slides.headline: Your team outing doesn't have to suck.
slides.body: Culture doesn't happen in a conference room. It happens when coworkers see each other outside one.

slides.headline: Mandatory fun. Conference room B. Pizza at noon.
slides.body: Somebody brings a trust-fall exercise. Everyone checks the clock. Nobody mentions it on Monday.

slides.headline: Same people. Same room. Same conversations.
slides.body: You can't expect a new conversation in the room where you have all the old ones.

slides.headline: Same team. On Clear Lake.
slides.body: Somebody's playlist is on. The quiet one is picking songs. Nobody is checking email.

slides.headline: Nobody's stuck at one table.
slides.body: People move around the boat, mix, and talk to someone new. A professional captain drives. Your team just shows up.
